svg.text: GotPhoto SEO / GEO Audit: how the n8n workflows fit together
1 main workflow · 5 sub-workflows · 1 error workflow · Claude Haiku 5.5 for judgment calls only
error output: page could not be loaded
reads the sitemap and builds the page list (legal pages left out)
audits one page · runs once for every page
→ orchestrator logs it in the "Failed" tab
Claude scores 5 criteria · quotes are checked
error workflow · fires if the orchestrator run crashes
ranks all findings · runs once with all pages
Solid arrows = data flow inside a workflow · dashed coloured arrows = one workflow calling another · dotted grey = AI model / parser attached to the Claude node
